blocks.html: Driven deep foundations shall be designed and installed in accordance with Sections 1810 and 1811.2 through 1811.7. Driven deep foundation elements shall be designed and manufactured in accordance with accepted engineering practice to resist all stresses induced by handling, driving and service loads.
